adaptations: GET /v1/audio-bibles/{audioBibleId}/books/{bookId}. Composio audioBibleId is the official bibleId path segment.
include_chapters maps to include-chapters.
GET /v1/audio-bibles/{audioBibleId}/books.
include_chapters and include_chapters_and_sections map to hyphenated official query names.
GET /v1/audio-bibles/{audioBibleId}/chapters/{chapterId} returns a temporary resourceUrl.
GET /v1/audio-bibles/{audioBibleId}/books/{bookId}/chapters.
GET /v1/audio-bibles/{audioBibleId}.
GET /v1/audio-bibles with optional language, abbreviation, name, ids, bibleId, and include_full_details (include-full-details).
GET /v1/bibles/{bibleId}.
Returns raw API.Bible JSON under data. Optional language, abbreviation, and name query filters match official docs and the pinned source.
Composio include_full_details maps to official include-full-details and is omitted when unset.
GET /v1/bibles/{bibleId}/search. Composio bible_id is bibleId.
query is required. Optional limit (1-100) and offset are omitted when unset.
GET /v1/bibles/{bibleId}/books/{bookId}. include_chapters maps to include-chapters.
bibleId is URL-encoded as a path segment. Official include-chapters query is omitted because the pinned source does not send it.
GET /v1/bibles/{bibleId}/books/{bookId}/sections maps Composio Get Sections.
GET /v1/bibles/{bibleId}/chapters/{chapterId}.
Composio content-type, include-notes, include-titles, include-verse-spans, include-verse-numbers, include-chapter-numbers, and parallels match official query names.
bibleId and bookId are URL-encoded as path segments. Returns raw API.Bible JSON under data.
GET /v1/bibles/{bibleId}/chapters/{chapterId}/sections.

Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /v1/bibles, the cheap authenticated catalog read used by the pinned credential validator. Pinned host is api.scripture.api.bible; current docs also document rest.api.bible as a future migration target that still accepts the same api-key header.
Native category is utility rather than data: API.Bible is a scripture catalog API, but Rust CATEGORIES has no data bucket; admitted ops are bible, book, chapter, and verse-identifier reads.
GET /v1/bibles/{bibleId}/passages/{passageId} with the same content-display query names as Get Chapter, plus use-org-id.
GET /v1/bibles/{bibleId}/sections/{sectionId}.
GET /v1/bibles/{bibleId}/verses/{verseId} with content-display options and use-org-id.
bibleId and chapterId are URL-encoded as path segments. This lists verse identifiers, not verse content.
